projects.title: Real-Time Communication System
projects.summary: Architected and implemented a high-performance real-time messaging platform supporting 500+ concurrent users with sub-millisecond packet routing, persistent storage, and zero error rates.

projects.title: UPI Offline Mesh Simulator
projects.summary: Engineered a fault-tolerant payment simulation framework enabling offline mesh transaction routing with cryptographic replay verification and idempotent settlement guarantees.

Implemented encryption with replay protection to ensure secure and tamper-resistant transaction transmission.
Built an idempotent transaction processing pipeline using atomic duplication and optimistic locking to prevent duplicate settlement during concurrent packet delivery.
